verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex is a SaaS payroll/HR platform that stores sensitive employee data, so data residency and region choice is a fair axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options, or customer-selectable data location; the 'every state where your employees work' item concerns tax remittance, not data storage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
